in_hebrew.name: Juliet
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Juliet הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Roman family name Julius, meaning 'youthful'. This name was popularized by Shakespeare's tragic heroine in 'Romeo and Juliet'.

in_latin.name: Juliet
